svg.title: Six-axis industrial robot arm, side view

g.title: Umbilical
g.desc: Thick cable from the base of the arm to the controller cabinet.

g.title: Controller cabinet
g.desc: Big grey box on the floor next to the arm; holds drives and computer.

g.title: Teach pendant
g.desc: Handheld tablet; red emergency stop on top, three-position enable switch on back.

g.title: Base
g.desc: Heavy cast block bolted to the floor; everything else sits on it.

g.title: J1 waist
g.desc: Rotates the whole arm left and right about a vertical axis.

g.title: Lower arm
g.desc: First long link, from the shoulder up to the elbow.

g.title: Counterbalance
g.desc: Spring cylinder on the back of the shoulder; helps J2 hold the arm up.

g.title: Turret
g.desc: On top of the waist; carries the shoulder joint on its side.

g.title: J2 shoulder
g.desc: On the side of the turret; swings the lower arm forwards and backwards.

g.title: J3 elbow
g.desc: At the top of the lower arm; raises and lowers the forearm.

g.title: J4 forearm roll
g.desc: Rolls the forearm about its own long axis; harmonic drive.

g.title: Forearm
g.desc: Second long link; sticks forwards horizontally to the wrist.

g.title: J5 wrist pitch
g.desc: Bends the wrist up and down; harmonic drive.

g.title: J6 flange roll
g.desc: Rolls the tool flange at the very end; harmonic drive.

g.title: Tool flange
g.desc: Round plate with bolt holes at the end of J6; takes the end effector.

g.title: Two-finger gripper
g.desc: Pneumatic; two parallel fingers that open and close on air.

g.title: Cables
g.desc: Motor power, encoder signals and air; come out along the top of the forearm.

g.title: Servo motor
g.desc: AC servo at each joint, encoder on its back, reducer around 100:1.
